content.title: Active Development Projects
content.summary: The city provides an interactive map for residents to track developments under review by the Community and Economic Development Work System. Public hearings for development projects are scheduled by the Planning Commission and City Council, with notifications published in the Arvada Press, mailed to nearby residents, and posted on-site. For more information about the development review process or to address specific inquiries, residents can contact the Planning Division or visit the city's website.
content.body:
Wondering what's going on at that construction site down the street, or what might be on the way in your neighborhood? Use our interactive [Developments Under Review Map](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=cb142677e3a046ac95cbdb32c9168534) for an updated list of developments under review by the Community and Economic Development Work System.

If you have questions or need assistance, please call 720-898-7435 or email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#afdfc0cbefceddd9cecbce81c0ddc8).

[Check the Development Map](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=cb142677e3a046ac95cbdb32c9168534)

## Private development meetings pending public hearing

The Planning Commission and City Council both hold public hearings for development projects when required by the [Land Development Code](https://www.arvadaco.gov/179/Land-Development-Code). To learn about proposed projects and pending public hearing dates, check the [Upcoming Public Hearings page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1223/Upcoming-Public-Hearings).

The public is notified three ways of a public hearing, there is a required publication in the Arvada Press, a required mailing (within required radius) and a sign is posted on the property. The cases on the [Upcoming Public Hearings page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1223/Upcoming-Public-Hearings) have been scheduled for hearing.

Properties posted with a development review sign are pending public hearing by the Planning Commission or by City Council. If you have more questions, please email the Planning Division or call 720-898-7435. You can also view all meeting procedures, agendas and meeting minutes on the [City Council page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/161/About-City-Council-Meetings) and the [Planning Commission page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/276/Planning-Commission).

## Want to know more about how the process works?

Check out the [Development Review Process page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1393/Development-Review-Process) for more details.
